name: Lyon silk scarf
where: L'Atelier de Soierie / Brochier Soieries, Rue Romarin
about: Lyon has a long tradition of silk printing, and the city was once famous for its silk weaving. A small scarf is an easy way to take that history home.
tip: Check the material and confirm it was made locally before you buy.

name: Coussin de Lyon (Lyon cushion candy)
about: These regional sweets are cushion-shaped and made with almond marzipan and chocolate. They are a classic Lyon treat.
tip: Buy a box sized for travel so it arrives in good shape.
